title: Individual Almond and Plum Tarts
changes_from_base: Crustless individual almond sponges baked around whole plums, in place of a pastry case with crème pâtissière.
summary: Quick individual almond sponges, each baked around a whole plum and served warm with soft cream.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Grind
steps.text: heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan). Pulse the almonds until finely ground but still dry, and tip into the small bowl. Over-ground almonds turn oily, so pulse in short bursts.

steps.title: Prepare the plums
steps.text: cut a small cross in the stalk end of each plum and ease out the stone, keeping the fruit whole.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: process the butter and sugar until smooth. Add the eggs, vanilla, salt, flour and ground almonds and pulse just until combined.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: share the batter between the ramekins on the tray. Push a plum, cut side up, into the middle of each; the top will sit proud of the batter.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: 15-20 min, until puffed, golden and springy at the edges. Serve straight away while the sponge is light.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: whip the cream with the icing sugar to soft peaks and spoon some onto each warm tart.

tips: Ground almonds from a packet save time; use 70 g.
Small apricots work in the same way.
Choose plums that fit snugly in the ramekins.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Best eaten warm on the day. Chill leftovers for up to 1 day and warm briefly before serving.
